method: pairs = same team-season, each >=1000 min, both charted; complementarity = 1-|cosine| of era-z profiles (orthogonal skills complement); success proxy = mean per-game plus-minus of the two (lineup on/off would be better — not freely available; stated limitation); chemistry = equal-weight percentile blend, a stated heuristic, not a truth claim; 2015-16 through 2025-26
